json.title: Pink Dawn Over Gangtok
json.logline: A family winter road trip to Gangtok culminates in a breath-taking glowing pink dawn over the high Himalayas.

character_rules: one protagonist with an unchanging silhouette, hair shape and jacket
eye shape and eye colour never change between scenes
the rim light always comes from behind the protagonist
style_bible.lighting: hard cyan rim light from behind with a magenta key from low left, shadows crushed to near-black
style_bible.medium: cel-shaded anime illustration with hard ink outlines, flat blocked shadows and speed lines behind anything moving

events.visual: Frosted glass reflects vibrant cyan light as dark silhouette appears.
Whip transition to high mountain highway road at night.
Fast light streaks pass over car windows ascending steep curves.
Massive Himalayan mountain peaks ignite in brilliant glowing pink dawn.
Quiet morning calm settles over frosted window ledger.
Panoramic mountain horizon opens up under brilliant morning skies.
Freeze frame holding high mountain peak ablaze with magenta sunlight.

scenes.camera_note: Framed tight on subject face with sharp cyan rim light
scenes.action: The young man turns his gaze toward a frosted window pane glistening with neon light.
scenes.setting: A dimly lit room in Gangtok with winter frost on the window glass.

scenes.camera_note: Rapid horizontal sweep tracking dark mountain road curves
scenes.action: A car ascends a steep winding mountain highway under electric cyan night skies.
scenes.setting: Winding high-altitude Himalayan cliff road leading to Gangtok.

scenes.camera_note: Slow smooth pan across car interior showing illuminated faces
scenes.action: The young man sits beside his family inside the moving vehicle overlooking distant valley lights.
scenes.setting: Vehicle interior with dark alpine landscape passing through glowing windows.

scenes.camera_note: Dynamic low angle whip up toward towering glowing mountain ridges
scenes.action: The young man stands on a high balcony as colossal snow peaks ignite in vibrant pink sunlight.
scenes.setting: Gangtok vantage point facing majestic snow-capped Himalayan ranges at dawn.

scenes.camera_note: Gentle floating drift over foreground object
scenes.action: A metal tea cup rests on a frosted wooden window ledge reflecting glowing pink peaks.
scenes.setting: Wooden windowsill overlooking the sunlit pink Himalayan horizon.

scenes.camera_note: Smooth dramatic pull back revealing vast mountain skyline
scenes.action: The young man gazes at the massive pink mountain range under a brilliant dawn sky.
scenes.setting: Panoramic high-mountain vista surrounding Gangtok at sunrise.
